info.name: Eureka LMS — Complete Platform API (Student, Teacher & Admin)
info.description:
# 🎓 Eureka LMS — Enterprise REST API & Real-time WebSockets

Automated, re-runnable Postman API collection with comprehensive positive and negative test suites, folder-level JWT authorization, interactive path/query parameters, and saved example responses.

---

## 🗺️ Organization
* **01. Shared Authentication & Verification**: Dynamic registration & login for all roles with instant token revocation.
* **02. Student Experience**: Academic discovery, home feed, auto-graded homework, timed exams, gamification, and 1-on-1 chat.
* **03. Teacher Management Suite**: Live QR attendance, group rosters, assignment wizards, manual essay grading queue, and financial ledgers.
* **04. Admin Management Portal**: 33 macro KPI, user lifecycle, teacher verification, financial audit, and multi-channel broadcast endpoints.
